required_erratum_judgment.independent_reasoning: During decreasing-volume compression condensation starts at the larger vapor endpoint and finishes at the smaller liquid endpoint. Earlier n38 text/fig54 defines these as V2 and V1 respectively. For the same mass of CO2 at a higher subcritical temperature, the vapor endpoint decreases and liquid endpoint increases, consistent with the narrower plateau and n39's independently read first paragraph. Preserving that established convention requires onset V2-prime<V2, completion V1-prime>V1 and liquid-filled endpoint V1-prime.
